description: G-code config-block suppression and Marlin power-loss mode transitions.

mutants.description: Invert the resolved-settings block gate; explicit false must retain the block and explicit true must suppress it while header/executable blocks remain.
Ignore the configured mode at the second-layer transition; enable and disable exports must fail their parsed M413 command contracts.
Omit the final disable after a by-layer print; enabled mode must turn recovery off after the last deposition.
